data.title: Data & Privacy
data.subtitle: DSGVO-ready export and deletion controls for organization data.
data.exportDesc: Export all organization-scoped Findr data as JSON. Integration secrets such as OAuth tokens and Slack webhook URLs are excluded.
data.exportAdminOnly: Only organization admins can export data.
data.gdprBody: Findr is designed for DACH sales teams: organization data can be exported, deleted, and kept separate by tenant. Production deployments should use EU-hosted Supabase infrastructure, for example Frankfurt, where required by the customer contract.
data.deleteDesc: This deletes Findr data for this organization: deals, calls, risk scores, loss analysis, alerts, and integration metadata. The Clerk organization and user accounts are not deleted.
data.deleted: Organization data deleted. The Clerk organization remains active.
data.deleteAdminOnly: Only organization admins can delete organization data.
